dict.string: OpenNote records audio notes and turns speech into text on this Mac when you ask it to.
OpenNote receives photos from your phone over this network when you choose Insert, then From phone.
OpenNote keeps your notebooks in the folder you choose, which is in Documents by default.
OpenNote opens and saves the files you choose on your desktop.
OpenNote opens and saves the files you choose in Downloads.
OpenNote opens and saves the notebooks and files you choose on a removable drive.
